title: The baking year
description: Equal-angle petals for each period of a cycle, with area proportional to the amount and values at the rim.

props.name: data
props.description: Three to twenty-four { id, label, value } periods in cycle order, clockwise from the top, with unique nonempty IDs. Finite nonnegative values are amounts; null, negative and non-finite values are unavailable and keep a dash at the rim. Zero has no petal. Petal radius follows the square root of the value, so area is proportional.

props.name: unitLabel
props.description: Caller-owned measurement heading and tooltip unit. Defaults to Value.

props.name: contextLabel
props.description: Optional caller-owned context beside the heading.

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Formats rim readings, tooltips and the screen-reader table. Defaults to en-US numbers with at most two decimal places.

props.name: animate
props.description: Defaults to true; the rosette opens once from its centre and honors live reduced-motion changes.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional container classes. The rosette stays square, at most 440px wide.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible chart title. Arrow keys inspect periods through Recharts.
